title: Kianuni/Erosion-CN
why_read: A similar niche iOS MobileGestalt-editing toolkit aimed at a Chinese-language jailbreak community, with narrow general applicability.
analysis: This is another MobileGestalt-focused configuration tool for iOS/iPadOS, described as a hardened toolkit for preventing 'white apple' boot failures during device tweaking, targeted at Chinese-speaking users. Like similar tools, it deals with low-level iOS internals used mainly by the jailbreak and device-modding community. It offers little broader technical insight for general software engineering audiences beyond that specific niche.
